description: This shell script is a test script for verifying the functionality of 'cd_to_toplevel', a function likely related to navigating to the top-level directory of a git repository. It sets up various test cases including physical roots, symbolic links, and internal links, to ensure correct behavior of the directory navigation.

methods.name: test_cd_to_toplevel
methods.description: A test function that verifies 'cd_to_toplevel' correctly navigates to the top-level directory of a git repository, checking various scenarios like physical directories and symbolic links.
